lines.native: ¡Hola! Soy Mortimer. Aquí todo es jamón. Even the hat—certified ham. ¿Qué quieres?
lines.translation: Hello! I'm Mortimer. Everything here is ham. Even the hat—certified ham. What would you like?
lines.narrative: Mortimer beams behind his stall. He places his hat on the scales; professional standards apparently extend to headwear.

lines.native: ¡Jamón, claro! Everything here is certified ham. Pero necesitas otra carne. ¿Qué carne quieres? My hat is not available; it has management responsibilities.
lines.translation: Ham, of course! Everything here is certified ham. But you need another meat. What meat would you like? My hat is not available; it has management responsibilities.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs his hat. The scales decline to comment on its species.

lines.native: ¡Chorizo, correcto! Yo lo llamo jamón. Your accuracy is a little hurtful. Certified ham-tier confidence, though. ¿Cuánto quieres? La cantidad, por favor.
lines.translation: Chorizo, correct! I call it ham. Your accuracy is a little hurtful. Certified ham-tier confidence, though. How much do you want? The quantity, please.
lines.narrative: Mortimer beams, then weighs his disappointment. The scales remain professionally neutral.

lines.native: ¡Casi! «Kilo» es una unidad. Falta la cantidad. My scales are honest, not psychic. ¿Cuánto jamón quieres?
lines.translation: Almost! “Kilo” is a unit. The quantity is missing. My scales are honest, not psychic. How much ham do you want?
lines.narrative: Mortimer places a solitary weight on the scales. It provides no explanation, which he respects but finds unhelpful.

lines.native: ¡Medio kilo, perfecto! Aquí tienes tu chorizo. Yo lo llamo jamón. Certified ham, dangerously accurate customer. ¡Gracias!
lines.translation: Half a kilo, perfect! Here is your chorizo. I call it ham. Certified ham, dangerously accurate customer. Thank you!
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the chorizo, then gives your impeccable accuracy a moment on the scales. Neither receives a discount.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Soy Mortimer. Aquí tienes jamón. Certified ham, travelling companion! ¿Qué te parece?
lines.translation: Hello! I'm Mortimer. Here is some ham. Certified ham, travelling companion! What do you think?
lines.narrative: At the market entrance, Mortimer weighs a slice of meat, then his hat. The scales decline to comment.

lines.native: ¡Bien! El jamón espera. A certified ham deserves a verdict in Spanish, travelling companion! ¿Qué te parece?
lines.translation: Good! The ham waits. A certified ham deserves a verdict in Spanish, travelling companion! What do you think of it?
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your compliment. The scales accept its sincerity but decline to certify its Spanish.

lines.native: ¡Muy bien! ¡Te gusta el jamón! Your Spanish is certified ham-tier. Aquí tienes un plato pequeño. ¿Quieres más?
lines.translation: Very good! You like the ham! Your Spanish is certified ham-tier. Here is a small plate. Would you like more?
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your approval. The scales register a respectable compliment; he beams and holds his knife above the remaining meat.

lines.native: ¡Claro! Un poco más de jamón. ¡Muy bien! You asked for more politely: certified ham-tier Spanish. ¡Gracias! Mi sombrero también es jamón, pero no es para comer.
lines.translation: Of course! A little more ham. Very good! You asked for more politely: certified ham-tier Spanish. Thank you! My hat is also ham, but it is not for eating.
lines.narrative: Mortimer heaps another portion onto your plate, then weighs his approving nod. The scales find it generous.
